svg.title: Common Operators
svg.desc: A left-right comparison graphic showing 20 Ligconsolata Next samples. The left side is shaped from a smoke-built font with liga, dlig, and calt enabled, and the right side is the same raw ASCII source with ligatures disabled.
svg.text: Common operators compact safely while URL and comment boundaries stay visible.
常用操作符安全压缩，同时保留 URL 和注释边界。

g.text: // / /// only ligate as comment prefixes followed by a normal space.
// 和 /// 只有后面跟普通空格、像注释前缀时才连写。
/* requires a following space, and */ requires a preceding space.
/* 需要后接空格，*/ 需要前接空格。
URLs, paths, and glob patterns keep raw slash glyphs.
URL、路径和 glob 模式里的斜线保持原始字形。
